about: Golden vectors for Home edit's drag (com.gpo.yoin.shared.home, parity p4; Android PR #292, owner 2026-11-22): the drop rules (a half's own row ± 16dp only changes sides across 0.45 / 0.55; over another full row its top and bottom quarters make a row of its own, its middle's outer 30% pairs; over a pair of two others a row of its own by the row's middle; never three across; no pairing while the edge scroll runs), the half-travel swap, the anchor, the edge scroll (72dp bands, 120 → 900dp/s eased by depth²) and its start guard (8dp push or 180ms rest), the exit rule, the layout catch-up check, the span handle and the pinch into the list. Generated from :shared Kotlin by HomeDragGoldenTest (androidHostTest); do not edit by hand. Lengths are px unless a name says dp; bands are whole px. Floats are rounded to 1e-4; compare within 1e-4. NaN is written "NaN". A row is one id or [left, right]; an arrangement is {ids, pairs}; a side step is {kind: Vertical | Stay | Arrange, arrangement?, side?}. sideStep vectors name a layout from "layouts" (the live arrangement, the dragged block, its side and the laid-out bands). timelines run HomeDragCore frame by frame on a fixed row model (see HomeDragTimelines.kt): started {side, grab}, one decision per frame (None | Step {arrangement, side} | Scroll {px, consumed}), then the result {write, arrangement, side, scrolled}.
